name: V.G. MAX
source:
A game in which the V.G. waitresses are rendered as super deformed (chibi) style characters. Includes the original six V.G. contestants, as well as Yajima Satomi from Advanced V.G., Mitsurugi Tamao from Advanced V.G. 2, Watanuki Yumiko from V.G. II and new character [spoiler]Houjouin Masako.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable_Geo#Games]Wikipedia[/url].]
translation:
一款将V.G.女招待们以Q版（chibi）风格呈现的游戏。包含原版六位V.G.参赛者，以及来自《Advanced V.G.》的矢岛聪美、《Advanced V.G. 2》的御剑玉绪、《V.G. II》的绵贯由美子，还有新角色[spoiler]宝条院雅子[/spoiler]。

[来自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable_Geo#Games]Wikipedia[/url]。]
